purpose: Milestone 4 criteria fixed before the numerical runs
notes: Exact realization and repeated coefficients are required within one build; projected traces have polynomial approximation error.
MPI field bounds account for reductions, iterative residual tolerance 1e-12, and pressure conditioning/time differentiation.
Restart flow history is reinitialized by the native IMEX integrator; compare bounded evolved error and timestep refinement, separately from exact inlet reconstruction.
Do not lower an acceptance standard after inspecting a failed result; diagnose representation, mapping, solver tolerance, or resolution.
